newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST-Portugal spreads seen widening with Bunds.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Portugal spreads seen widening with Bunds.

text.p: The following is the daily forecast for spreads in the Portuguese bond market based on a poll of five banks.
Poll covers spreads between the February 2007 Portuguese
cash bond (OT) and the German and Spanish equivalents, together
with the spreads between the Portuguese 10 and two-year bonds.
Min spread Avge Max vs previous close
Key factors likely to affect market:

-The 10-years seen easing in greater volatility given the surprising victory of the left in first-round voting in France. But despite the easing of the escudo, support seen strong for the shorter end and the curve should steepen.
Note: YLDS3 is still calculated on basis of Feb 06 bond.
